verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying Rev AI can be deployed in the cloud or on-prem. An on-prem deployment would let a customer keep data in infrastructure they control, which is a coarse form of residency choice. Nothing documents selectable cloud regions or residency guarantees, and HIPAA processing is a compliance control, not a residency feature. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/residency selection (e.g., EU vs US endpoints), details on how on-prem deployment is obtained and configured, and data-location guarantees or independent corroboration.
